rationale: Minimal complete learning for the end of this run: a compact handoff of what was confirmed and what remains, so the next run starts from the outcomes rather than from the transcripts. Every entry below was produced by a fixed artifact executed by the trusted runner and then reviewed with no open issue; the single holds entry is the bounded negative on the overlap window. No map object changes, because each answered question already updated the relevant surface or obligation when it was accepted, and nothing here is offered as new evidence.

feedback.answered: Eleven obligations were confirmed by executed and reviewed checks. Election-term context: a heartbeat-shaped AppendEntries handled on the transport's connection goroutine can publish a current term below one the node already reported adopting, reproduced both with a substitute stream layer and with the production TCP transport. Client futures: requests accepted by a leader can go unresolved after the node becomes inactive, and a request accepted while leading can remain unresolved after shutdown. Vote record: a node that persisted a vote can persist a second, different vote for the same term after its published term dropped. Leadership: two leaders of one term can hold leadership at the same time (the overlap-window variant is a bounded negative, holds). Client contract: GetConfiguration reports an index of zero for a configuration established at index one, and an entry a node reports as committed can be one the voting quorum does not store. Lease: a leader with a reachable quorum can still step down under the lease check. Commit context: a node that installs a snapshot at index 43 publishes commit_index 0 while applied and last are 43, both on the runtime install path and again after a restart that restores its own snapshot, with Stats reporting the same pair. Verification: VerifyLeader reports success when the only reachable acknowledgements besides the leader's own vote come from non-voters, reproduced with one non-voter (two voters) and with two non-voters (three voters) against a voter majority the leader cannot reach.
remaining: Repair locations are open for the whole set: serialising the heartbeat callback or making the handler concurrency-safe for the term-context findings, completing or rejecting accepted futures for the client-contract ones, and filtering verification votes by suffrage or excluding non-voter replication states for the quorum finding. No source states which layer is intended.
No consumer outside the module was exercised for any of the client-contract findings, so their downstream consequence is argued from the documented contracts rather than observed.

The campaign path of a server that holds no vote is not fully read: voters refuse a non-voter candidate by an explicit guard, but whether such a candidate can ever win after a promotion race was not traced.
The transfer path accepts a non-voter as a target and reported success while no leader of either kind was established, which two exploration prefixes recorded and no obligation covers.

Deferred and unread: third-party SetHeartbeatHandler transports, the MonotonicLogStore and snapshot-compaction interplay, the nested fuzzy and raft-compat modules, and mixed configurations with both reachable voters and reachable non-voters.
Exploration and construction runs in this session are not evidence; only the cited executed checks are.
feedback.rationale: This product exists only to preserve the session's outcome compactly: the confirmed responsibilities with the executed witness for each, the one bounded negative, and the concrete open items, so that a later run can go straight to the unread paths or to the repair questions instead of re-deriving the map. It claims no map change and no new evidence.
